main_text.head: QUARTUM MEMBRUM, DE quarto & postremo Christi ingressu in Hierosolymam, & quid in urbe & circa eam gesserit, & perpessus sit.
main_text.l: Lorio[?] pedum humilis atque demissa. cap.13.
Egrediundum in hortum, oratio eius ad
Adhortatoria, ad constantem in fide & officio perseverantiam.c.15.
Deum patrem precatoria pro se ipso, discipulos & totā Ecclesiā. cap.17.
Horto & atrio Pontificis: quibus etiam accedunt acta quaedam in Praetorio Pilati. cap.18.
Praetorio Præsidis & loco supplicij atque sepulturæ. cap.19.
Versantibus in Iudæa, & adhuc Hierosolymis agentibus. cap.20.
Revertis in Galilæam, & ad mare Tyberiadis piscantibus. cap.21.

page.notes: The left margin line is set vertically and partly rotated; its words are read with some doubt. "Lorio" in the diagram may be "Lotio". The small mark at the foot of the diagram is a printer's mark or signature and is not transcribed. The rest of the page reads clearly.
